search_log: Searched site:tor.com and site:reactormag.com for "A Memory of Light" excerpts, including the prologue and Chapters 1 and 11; opened the authorized prose pages.

Searched the title with "point of view", "third person", "narrator", and "multiple POV"; a Tar Valon Library chapter list documented many focal characters but did not explicitly establish grammatical person.
Opened Macmillan's book page to verify the work and authorship; its catalog synopsis was not treated as narrator-person evidence.
Searched exact text from q00012 and q00025 to restore omitted context; results placed q00012 in a Mat-centered third-person scene and confirmed q00025 as Rand's dialogue to Aviendha.
Searched for NPR's "Exclusive First Read" excerpt, but the page was blocked by robots.txt and was not used as evidence.
person_note: The controlling narration is third person with numerous character focalizers. Diagnostic quote passages follow Lan, Logain, and Rand through third-person action or interior perception, while three authorized excerpts independently show the same form in the prologue, full opening chapter, and an interior chapter. Apparent first-person evidence is local dialogue, an attributed missive, or embedded character reflection; notably, live context confirms q00025 is Rand's speech despite its event bucket. The quote sample is dialogue-heavy, but the authorized prose has broad enough sectional coverage to leave no credible indication of sustained first- or second-person base narration.
